verdict.rationale: Dagster natively supports scheduling recurring jobs via Schedules (cron-based intervals), event-driven Sensors, and Declarative Automation for asset-based triggers, all well documented, plus Dagster+ MCP server and AI skills allow an AI-native user to set these up programmatically or via agent tooling. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of AI agents successfully configuring schedules end-to-end, and no evidence of natural-language scheduling interface.
